mission.label: A PEOPLE COMMITTED TO PRAYER
mission.heading: Raising a people who stand in the gap for nations.
paragraphs: Million Plus Intercessors is a Christian prayer and intercession focused movement. We exist to encourage and mobilise believers in devoted prayer for individuals, families, communities, churches, and nations.

At the heart of the movement is the biblical conviction that God calls His people to stand before Him in intercession. When believers unite with sincerity and spiritual commitment, prayer produces lasting spiritual and practical transformation.

Through prayer fellowships, discipleship teachings, and regular intercession initiatives, we encourage believers everywhere to cultivate persistent personal prayer and participate in corporate intercession.

founder.name: Emmanuel Olu Falodun
founder.title: Ministry History & Leadership
paragraphs: Million Plus Intercessors is connected with the wider Christian ministry work and teaching of Emmanuel Olu Falodun, reflecting a longstanding commitment to prayer, fasting, Christian discipleship, and spiritual leadership.

Rooted in biblical foundations and active across multiple ministry platforms, the vision remains simple: to call believers back to fervent prayer, foster godly unity, and inspire a generation that seeks God for community and continental revival.
founder.quote: When believers take their place in genuine intercession, they participate in what God is doing across nations.
